news.headline: CrowdStrike, Zscaler Merger Would Create Cybersecurity Giant
news.summary: CrowdStrike stock fell and Zscaler stock popped amid a report the companies are in merger talks. A deal would create a cybersecurity giant.

news.headline: Dow Jones Futures: Market Has Worst Week Since Covid Amid Nvidia, Anthropic. Does Fear Gauge Offer Hope?
news.summary: The Dow Jones and Nasdaq had their worst week since March 2020, fueled by Nvidia and Anthropic. A fear gauge is soaring. Good news?

news.headline: Zscaler stock soars on reports that CrowdStrike is eyeing a possible buyout
news.summary: Zscaler (ZS) shares are surging in Friday's after-hours trading following Bloomberg reporting that CrowdStrike (CRWD) is in talks to buy the cybersecurity firm.

news.headline: Zscaler Stock Soars 18% On CrowdStrike Takeover Report. $32 Billion Cybersecurity Deal In Focus.
news.summary: Zscaler shares jumped about 18% after a report that CrowdStrike was discussing a takeover of the cybersecurity company, valued at roughly $32 billion.

news.headline: ZS Stock Soars After-Hours While CRWD Slips On Reported $265B Takeover Talks
news.summary: CrowdStrike is in talks to buy Zscaler, according to people familiar with the matter cited by Bloomberg.

news.headline: CrowdStrike Said in Talks to Buy Cybersecurity Firm Zscaler
news.summary: CrowdStrike Holdings Inc. is in talks to acquire Zscaler Inc., according to people familiar with the matter, in a deal that would be among the largest-ever in the cybersecurity sector. Zscaler, which had a market value of $32 billion at the end of regular trading Friday, rose about 16% after the close.
